limitations: Coupled source-managed Singleton/Registry/backend admission only, not privileged external SQL isolation.
No registration, release, native host or power-loss persistence permit.
Three SQL-file checks are initialization point observations only; never an atomic parser receipt or later-current-file claim.
Owner checks perform no file/SQL IO and validate stored immutable executed snapshots plus private generation.
Electron ASAR uses original-fs physical container FD/generation observations plus virtual fixed SQL type/size/hash/inventory; virtual inode/time are not certificates.
ASAR queries must be packed under container/queries; virtual symlinks and adjacent unpacked queries are refused; observations are not a disk lease.
